The '''''[[Lunar Shadow]]'' Captain''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] who enjoyed frequenting the [[Jekk'Jekk Tarr]]; he was known to stay in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] until he lost consciousness, eventually stumbling back to his quarters in the [[flophouse]] located on the [[Nar Shaddaa Docks]]. On one such occasion he was approached by [[Meetra Surik]], who had been asked by his [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] crew to keep a watch out for their captain, as the air in the cantina was toxic for their [[Species/Legends|species]]. Apparently the ''Lunar Shadow'' was due for departure and the crew was distressed that the captain would not return in time.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', the player can enter the Jekk'Jekk Tarr without a [[Environment suit/Legends|spacesuit]] before the meeting with [[Visquis]] is triggered, providing that the player character is equipped with a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]]; this way the ''Lunar Shadow'' captain can be contacted before the cantina patrons become hostile. Otherwise, if the meeting has been triggered, the captain will be approached by the spacesuit-clad [[Mira]].

Conversely, the Exile has the choice to convince the irritated crew members to abandon their wayward captain and hire the [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]] [[Odis]] as their [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. Either way, the captain cannot be killed and is the only patron of the Jekk'Jekk Tarr to remain neutral during the skirmish.

If the [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (First Jedi Purge)|Mission to Nar Shaddaa]] mission has already taken place, it will be impossible to talk with the captain as the player is no longer able to enter the Jekk'Jekk Tarr.
